name: Unnecessary Middle Man
hint: Using a broadcast receiver only to send a broadcast again is considered a code smell, as the script is a middle man between the original sender and the final receiver.[newLine]Consider changing the message of the final receiver to the message sent of the first broadcast and then delete the middle man eliminate redundant code.
instruction: Using a broadcast receiver only to send a broadcast again is considered a code smell, as the script is a middle man between the original sender and the final receiver.[newLine]Consider changing the message of the final receiver to the message sent of the first broadcast and then delete the middle man eliminate redundant code.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when [space v] key pressed
broadcast [message1 v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when [space v] key pressed
broadcast [message v] :: #007000 //⇦  👍

examples.label: Error 2
examples.scratchblocks:
when I receive [message1 v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
broadcast [message2 v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛

examples.label: Error 3
examples.scratchblocks:
when I receive [message2 v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
glide (2) secs to [Baby v]

examples.label: Possible Solution 3
examples.scratchblocks:
when I receive [message v] :: #007000 //⇦ 👍 
glide (2) secs to [Baby v]
